title: Learn and Earn: Wisdom of Bharat & Mathematics
description: Daily educational challenge combining Vedic wisdom from the Bhagavad Gita and foundational Mathematics through Class 6.

questions.question: A warrior in Kalinga collected 348 iron arrows in the morning and 475 arrows in the evening. How many total arrows were collected?
The royal treasury had 1,000 gold coins. If 365 coins were allocated to restore the temple wheels, how many coins remain?
Solve the algebraic equation for x: 3x + 15 = 45. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Subtract 15 from both sides: 3x = 30. Divide by 3: x = 10.

questions.question: A square courtyard inside the Konark temple complex has a side length of 24 meters. What is its total perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a square = 4 × side = 4 × 24 = 96 meters.

questions.question: If 4y - 7 = 29, what is the value of 2y + 5?
Simplify the fraction sum: (3/8) + (2/8). What is the resulting fraction?

questions.shlokaSnippet: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana | mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo'stvakarmaṇi ||
questions.question: From which chapter and verse of the Bhagavadgītā (Gita Press) is this renowned shloka on selfless action taken?
questions.explanation: Chapter II (Sāṅkhyayoga / The Yoga of Knowledge), Verse 47: 'Your right is to work only and never to the fruit thereof...'

questions.shlokaSnippet: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata | abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham ||
questions.question: Identify the Chapter and Verse number of this sacred declaration by Bhagavān Śrī Kṛṣṇa:
questions.explanation: Chapter IV, Verse 7: 'Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.'

questions.shlokaSnippet: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama ||
questions.question: In the final verse of the Bhagavadgītā, Sañjaya declares where victory and righteousness reside. Which Chapter and Verse is this?
questions.explanation: Chapter XVIII (The Yoga of Liberation through the Path of Knowledge and Self-Surrender), Verse 78.

questions.shlokaSnippet: ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate | teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham || [9.22]
questions.question: This verse promising divine protection appears in Chapter IX. What is the English title of Chapter IX according to Gita Press?
options: The Yoga of Sovereign Science and the Sovereign Secret
questions.explanation: Chapter IX is entitled 'The Yoga of Sovereign Science and the Sovereign Secret' (Rājavidyā-Rājaguhya-Yoga).

questions.shlokaSnippet: uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet | ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ||
questions.question: Identify the chapter title and verse number where the Lord instructs: 'One should lift oneself by one's own efforts...'
options: Chapter VI (The Yoga of Self-Control), Verse 5
Chapter XIII (The Field and Knower), Verse 11
questions.explanation: Chapter VI (The Yoga of Self-Control / Dhyānayoga), Verse 5.

questions.shlokaSnippet: na jāyate mriyate vā kadācinnāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ | ajo nityaḥ śāśvato'yaṃ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre ||
questions.question: This fundamental verse teaching that the soul is unborn, eternal, and indestructible is found at which location?
questions.explanation: Chapter II, Verse 20 in the section Sāṅkhyayoga (The Yoga of Knowledge).
